overview: The Ten Thousand Immortals test token (TTTI-T): mint with ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT or BTC, a built-in wallet, buyback, and native liquidity pools.
features: Mint TTTI-T with ICP, ckBTC, ckUSDC, ckUSDT or BTC
Mint revenue sent automatically to an owner wallet set per token in the admin screen, with send history
Mint fee split between liquidity providers and permanent liquidity of the least liquid TTTI-T pair
Native liquidity pools with swap fees split 70% to providers and 30% to permanent liquidity
Automatic cycles top-up with a 2 ICP reserve
Built-in wallet, buyback, history and corrected white paper in 7 languages
